name: AFFiNE MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with AFFiNE workspaces through GraphQL API to manage documents, search content, handle comments, and access version history. Supports comprehensive workspace operations including document publishing, comment management, and user authentication via session cookies or personal access tokens.

MCP_WS_PORT.description: Host port to expose for WebSocket transport

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' for stdio mode, or 'ws' for WebSocket

AFFINE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your AFFiNE server, e.g. http://affine.local:3010

AFFINE_API_TOKEN.description: Personal access token for Bearer auth

AFFINE_HEADERS_JSON.description: Optional JSON of extra headers to send

AFFINE_WORKSPACE_ID.description: Default workspace id (optional). Tools also accept explicit workspaceId
